title: Impulse Response of a Time-Varying Sample-and-Hold System
expert_review: This problem provides a deep theoretical look at how sampling is represented in the context of continuous-time integral equations. It's a sophisticated application of the Dirac delta function.
learning_objectives: Formulate the impulse response for a non-time-invariant system
Apply the sifting property of the Dirac delta function to evaluate system kernels
Relate the piecewise constant output of a sample-and-hold system to its integral representation
Understand the mathematical distinction between LTI convolution and LTV kernel integration
